sloka: सुग्रीवेण च मे सख्यम् लक्ष्मणेन यथा तथा ।दार राज्य निमित्तम् च निःश्रेयसकरः स मे ॥४-१८-२६॥
transliteration: sugrīveṇa ca me sakhyam lakṣmaṇena yathā tathā ।dāra rājya nimittam ca niḥśreyasakaraḥ sa me ॥4-18-26॥

translations.english: 'My friendship with Sugriva is as strong as that with Lakshmana. Its motive is the recovery of his wife and sovereignty. I have promised this to him in the presence of monkeys. How can a pledge remain unhonoured by a person like me? How is it possible?
